lines.text: About the Authors
Ms,RaheelaAwais
Ms. Raheela Awais is a renowned educationist delivering her services in the capacity of
Principal in the public sector educational institution in Islamabad. With an excellent
academic record, she completed her Master's degree in Geography from the University of
Punjab. She holds a post graduate degree in Educational Planning and Management (EPM).
She has specialized skills in Inclusive Education. As a coordinator, she visited Indonesia for the
graduate level course from the Universityof Oslo, Norwayin Special Needs Education.
As a master trainer of Federal Directorate of Education (FDE), she has conducted various
teacher's training workshops for projects collaborated with international organizations like IDp
Norway, Children Global Network (CGN), and Canadian International Development Agency
(CIDA). She has contributed as "Reviewer in discipline of Geography" towards development of
curriculum at national/provincial levels with Curriculum Wing (ICT)and PunjabTextbook Board
Additionally, she is the author of Social Studies Textbook developed for class 5th inAzad Jammi
& Kashmir. She also served as an author of Geography Textbook for class 6 to 8 developed bv
NationalBookFoundation.
Forqueries aboutChapter1and5pleasecontactat:raheela-awais@hotmail.com.

Prof.Muhammad Javaid
Prof. Muhammad Javaid is working as Chairman, Department of Geography at Islamabad Mode
Postgraduate College H-8. He did M.Sc. in Geography from University of Punjab, Lahore ang
M.Ed. from AIOU Islamabad. He joined education department of Federal Government in 1997. He
has taught Physical and Regional Geography at Intermediate and Degree levels from 1997 to 200
and Climatology, Oceanography and Geography of Pakistan to M.Sc. Geography classes fron
2004 to 2021. Since 2021, he has been teaching different courses to BS Geography.
He is co-author of Geography and Pakistan studies books for Middle and Higher Secondary levels
published by NBF and AIOU respectively. He participated in a Training Course on ICT in Educatio
offered by Incheon Metropolitan City Office of Education, Incheon (Korea) in 2008. He has als
been a part of the Social Studies Curriculum development team for Grade 4 and 5 in 2017.
For queries about Chapter numbers 2 and 3, please contact muhammadjavaid1970@gmail.com
